# telnyx_ai_memory_namespace (Resource)

A memory namespace, where AI assistants keep what they remember about the people they talk to.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "telnyx_ai_memory_namespace" "example" {
  name = "support"
}

resource "telnyx_ai_memory_namespace_settings" "example" {
  namespace = telnyx_ai_memory_namespace.example.name
  summary = {
    instructions = "Remember the customer's products and open tickets."
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The namespace's name, used in the path. `default` exists for every organization.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The namespace's unique identifier.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import telnyx_ai_memory_namespace.example <name>
```
